prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-30):
| Current ratio           | 1.27 |
| Retained earnings       | 17,093M |
| Current liabilities     | 28,136M |
| Current assets          | 35,630M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 18,552M |
| Total liabilities       | 78,289M |
| Total assets            | 96,889M |
| EBIT / operating income | 3,639M |
| Revenue                 | 12,222M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
Key factors: The company shows solid operating profitability (EBIT 3,639M on revenue 12,222M) but carries very high leverage (total liabilities ~78.3B vs total assets ~96.9B, equity ~18.6B). Liquidity is modest (current ratio 1.27) with positive working capital, yet debt burden and limited cushion against earnings volatility suggest meaningful credit risk.

DECISION: BBB-
